title: S&P 500 Relief Rally Still Depends on Oil Falling Below $90 | Investing.com
summary: The market reacted positively to a geopolitical development where the Trump administration proposed a framework to end the war with Iran, potentially resolving a major conflict affecting global oil supply and markets. The framework includes Iran's dismantling of nuclear infrastructure and reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, with the U.S. demanding closure of all American military bases in the Gulf.
sentiment_reason: The market's strong positive reaction is due to the potential for a resolution to the ongoing conflict, which has been causing volatility and uncertainty in global markets, particularly in the oil sector.
